name: Gauntlets of War Mastery
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot hands; Price 10,350 gp; Weight .5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Made from adherer hide, these gauntlets grant the wearer enhanced combat abilities and an iron grip on their weapons. These gauntlets grant its wearer a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with melee weapons and a +1 bonus on CMD and saving throw rolls to resist being disarmed or dropping a held weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells bull’s strength, magic weapon, resistance; Cost 5,175 gp
